## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` new functionality (minor)
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `chore` maintenance
- [ ] `docs` documentation
- [ ] `ci` CI/CD or automation
- [ ] `refactor` no behavior change
- [ ] `test` tests only
- [ ] `perf` performance
- [ ] `build` build system or dependencies
- [ ] `style` formatting only
- [ ] `revert` reverts an earlier change
- [ ] `ai` agent prompts, skills, or AI config
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in title or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, major)
